import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
import re

# Try the search page on yidaiyilu.gov.cn
url = 'https://www.yidaiyilu.gov.cn/search/?keyword=%E7%AB%A3%E5%B7%A5'
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
    content = resp.read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
    # Extract article links
    links = re.findall(r'href="(/p/[A-Z0-9]+\.html)"[^>]*>([^<]+)', content)
    unique = {}
    for link, title in links:
        title = title.strip()
        if title and link not in unique:
            unique[link] = title
    print(f'Search results: {len(unique)} articles')
    for link, title in sorted(unique.items()):
        print(f'{title} -> {link}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Search page Error: {e}')
